# SaneApps

> SaneApps makes small, privacy-first apps for Mac, iPhone and iPad, built by one independent developer ("Mr. Sane"). Apps are on-device by default, have no subscriptions, and publish their source code on GitHub (PolyForm Shield licence). Direct Mac apps include every feature free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase.

## Mac apps
- SaneClip: private clipboard manager with Touch ID lock, AES-256 encrypted history, OCR capture and a free iPhone companion. $14.99 once. https://saneclip.com/ (llms.txt: https://saneclip.com/llms.txt)
- SaneHosts: system-wide ad, tracker and distraction blocking through the Mac hosts file, with 200+ curated blocklists and five protection levels. $14.99 once. https://sanehosts.com/
- SaneClick: 62 Finder right-click actions (OCR, image conversion, PDF merge, scripts). $14.99 once. https://saneclick.com/
- SaneSales: private revenue tracker for indie sellers on Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and Stripe; Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. https://sanesales.com/
- SaneVideo: local Mac screen and camera recorder with editing, captions and transcription; nothing is uploaded. https://sanevideo.com/
- SaneApps Bundle: SaneClip, SaneClick, SaneHosts, SaneSales for Mac and SaneVideo for $49.99 once. https://saneapps.com/bundle

## iPhone and iPad
- SaneScan: free private document scanner with local OCR and PDF export, no account. https://sanescan.saneapps.com/

## Other projects
- SaneCite: an open checker of the scientific record; Campaign One audits how retracted papers keep getting cited. https://sanecite.com/ (llms.txt: https://sanecite.com/llms.txt)
- LanaTax: free in-browser Solana transaction export for tax tools. https://tax.saneapps.com/

## Facts
